title: Why Truck Payments Hit Record Highs (1 in 5 Buyers Now Pay $1,000 a Month)
description:
Why truck payments hit record highs in 2026: $67,573 average full-size pickup prices, longer loans, 7% rates, record-low down payments, negative equity and insurance, with worked loan examples and seven ways to lower your payment. Every number comes from a published source, listed below.

Get the 2027 Truck Buyer's Guide: [LINK HERE]

0:00 Intro
1:48 The new payment records
4:36 Reason 1: Truck prices
7:07 Reason 2: Tariffs and destination fees
9:44 Reason 3: Longer loans
11:36 Reason 4: Negative equity
14:13 Reason 5: Rates, down payments and insurance
17:49 How to lower your payment
20:22 The verdict
